title: Join us Dec. 16…Bears v. Packers Holiday Tailgate Party!
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Watersports invited the community to a Bears v. Packers holiday tailgate party on December 16, 2012, with food and drinks provided.
body_html: Snacks, food, water/pop, dessert, ice/coolers & mixers will be provided. Feel free to bring your own “adult beverages” of choice.
seo_title: Bears v. Packers Holiday Tailgate Party Dec. 16
seo_description: Join Quest Watersports for a Bears v. Packers holiday tailgate party on December 16, 2012 in Ottawa, IL. Snacks, food, pop and dessert are provided.
